text:
Anna Lee: Quick sync from today's compact triage — we finished the initial pass on the wave-1 post-launch backlog. Need alignment on 3 items: a client-reported embed regression, a UX jitter in streaming, and a low-frequency memory leak.
Matt H: can you paste the customer repro for the embed regression? I want to know if it's correctness vs performance.
Anna Lee: pasted below from the support thread: 
```
User: embeddings for long docs drifted after deploy; similarity score drops ~0.2 for same paragraph. Same prompt, different model variant.
Steps: submit doc via bulk endpoint -> embeddings -> cosine with past embedding.
Seen on dedicated clusters only.
```
Devon: thanks. Sounds like a model-variant mismatch or quantization artifact. That's likely a correctness risk for customer search.
Sara K: UX jitter in streaming: we observed 250–400ms gaps between initial tokens and continuation on mobile when network fluctuates. Not reproducible on desktop. Filed as #STREAM-321.
Jordan (PM): Proposal: must-fix for the embed regression (customer SLA hit), high-priority bug for mobile streaming (degrades activation), memory leak = P2 (low frequency, no data loss). Thoughts?
Matt H: agree on embed regression = must-fix. We should roll a canary to the affected dedicated pool and compare embeddings before/after. Assigning to me and Devon.
Devon: I'll run a small eval suite: 2000 paragraphs across lengths, compare cosine distributions between variants v1/v1-q8. ETA EOD tomorrow. If distribution shift > 0.1 we'll revert quantized variant.
Anna Lee: For UX jitter, can we mitigate with client-side buffering + server-side heartbeat? Short-term band-aid vs longer fix.
Sara K: client buffer helped in local tests. I'll ship a small SDK patch that delays first chunk by 150ms when on cellular. Not ideal but buys time.
Jordan (PM): Acceptance criteria for ship:
- Embed regression: customer test returns >= baseline sim score for 95% of corpus OR variant reverted.
- Streaming jitter: mobile SDK patch deployed + 1 week of telemetry showing 50% reduction in gap events.
- Memory leak: reproduce internally + fix or clear rollback plan if not resolved in 2 sprints.
Anna Lee: Triage buckets:
- must-fix (customer-facing correctness, SLA): embed regression -> rollout block until canary validated
- urgent-fix (degrades core activation): streaming jitter -> mitigations + infra trace
- backlog (low-sev): memory leak -> scheduled patch
Matt H: I'll open two PRs: canary rollback playbook + eval harness. Ping @ops-bot to schedule canary run at 02:00 UTC.
ops-bot: scheduled canary run for dedicated-pool-3 at 02:00 UTC. Notifying owners: Matt H, Devon.
Devon: quick note — if canary shows no regression, we still should run a token-level diff on outputs to be safe. I'll add logging for first 100 tokens.
Sara K: I'll prepare the SDK patch and a short release note for customers on mobile latency improvements.
Jordan (PM): timeline check: embed regression fix must be validated within 48 hours for the impacted customer. If not, offer temporary routing to hosted API and a credit.
Anna Lee: ok. Owners: embed = Matt H + Devon; streaming = Sara K; memory leak = Anna. I'll update the roadmap board and move these into "hotfix lane".
Matt H: noted. Will post canary results to this thread. :thumbsup:
Anna Lee: thanks everyone — compact follow-up at 11:00 tomorrow if any of the canary/eval outcomes require escalation.
